summary: Request: tenant-scoped, HMAC-signed SIEM stream with per-field tokenization and retention proof
description: FinWave requests a real-time SIEM export option that meets their compliance requirements: tenant-scoped streams (separate per-customer delivery), HMAC-signed delivery batches, optional field-level tokenization (PII redaction replaced with reversible tokens), and an append-only retention proof (cryptographic manifest) for monthly audit bundles. They also want evidence artifacts (signed manifests) that prove delivery times and integrity for SOC 2 review.
impact: Customer cannot complete SOC 2 audit without cryptographically provable delivery and field-level tokenization. Current available export options (SFTP batch, daily archives) are insufficient for real-time detection integration and do not satisfy FinWave's evidence requirements.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer subscribes to audit export via Console -> Integrations -> SIEM -> Create stream
2) Select 'Real-time webhook' delivery, enable 'tenant-scoped' checkbox and toggle 'field tokenization' to 'on', supply callback URL
3) Observe that webhook payloads are missing x-redwood-signature header and manifest link is not present in payload
4) Attempt to validate payloads against customer's HMAC key fails (no signature), and reconstructed monthly manifest is empty for this tenant

investigation_notes: Initial triage by Support: confirmed customer configuration in Console shows 'tenant-scoped' enabled and 'field tokenization' on. Callback URL reachable and responding with 200s.

Checked webhook-delivery logs: deliveries show signature_present=false for multiple batches in March window. Delivery service did not attach x-redwood-signature header for tenant-scoped streams due to codepath guard clause introduced in release 2026-02-28.

Reproduced locally in staging with tenant-scoped flag: webhook pipeline skipped signing step because 'per_tenant_secret' lookup returned null for tenants created before 2026-02-01. FinWave tenant created 2025-11-04.

Manifest generator relies on batched archive writes from s3-archive pipeline; for tenant-scoped streams archive keys were being written to a global prefix rather than tenant prefix, manifest aggregator filter missed them, producing an empty manifest for this tenant.
Hypothesis: two regressions introduced in 2026-02-28 release: (1) signing disabled for legacy tenants if per_tenant_secret not present, (2) archive prefixing bug for tenant-scoped exports.

Customer provided sample payloads and their HMAC key. Verified HMAC calculation fails when signature header absent. Verified same payload signed with computed HMAC matches expected when header present.

Escalated to SRE and Runtime teams: linked INT-3321 for deploy rollback/hotfix and INT-3347 for manifest path fix. Raised PR attempt in infra repo: github.com/redwood/infer/PR#4987 (see related_github_prs)
Security note: field-level tokenization implementation uses reversible token mapping managed by KMS; customer requested evidence of key wrapping policy. Security team engaged via #sec-support.

Workaround identified: Enable sftp-batch export for tenant to obtain daily bundles while engineering works on real-time stream fixes. This bypasses webhook signing requirement but provides manifests for audits.

resolution: Hotfix deployed 2026-03-12: webhook delivery now attaches x-redwood-signature for tenant-scoped streams even when per-tenant secret is missing (fallback to service key with explicit audit-event).

Manifest aggregator fixed and backfill run: manifests regenerated for March and March-manifest.json is signed and includes per-batch checksums and s3 URIs. Manifest signed with service KMS key; signature artifact attached to Confluence evidence page.

Security artifacts provided: KMS key policy excerpt, key rotation schedule, and signed manifest delivered to customer via secure SFTP. Confluence evidence page: https://confluence.redwood/finwave/audit-evidence-2026-03
Workaround closure: Customer accepted SFTP daily bundles as interim until webhook signing verified end-to-end. We validated sample payloads and signature verification with customer-provided HMAC key.

Follow-up actions: INT-3347 for permanent per-tenant secret provisioning flow; add schema field 'manifest_uri' to realtime webhook payloads (product request PR#4992); update runbook for signing fallback behavior.
Ticket status: Marked for customer verification. Pending customer confirmation that received signed manifest and webhook deliveries validate.
